history_summary: Record generic reference correspondences for the substrate-adapted rumen enrichment descriptors.
history_details: The pinned native crosswalk adds fourteen genus/family correspondence blocks, fifteen grounding statuses and the complete ordered five-option Megasphaera ambiguity, followed by two actual native inline events. Prevotella_1 and Prevotella_7 remain distinct source SILVA bins despite sharing the same 6827/6827 generic genus population. Prevotellaceae_YAB2003_group and Rikenellaceae_RC9_gut_group remain broader-family descriptors, not reclassified experimental ASVs. The Selenomonas-to-Centipeda relation is 278/482 references, Fibrobacter-to-Hallerella is 47/54, and the family Prevotellaceae-to-Bacteroidaceae relation is 15757/15757; native name differences do not rename the study organisms. Rounded fractions below one are not unanimity, stock confidence or experimental abundance. No single block or invented denominator is assigned to ambiguous Megasphaera. All reference populations are separate from the four substrate enrichment lines, absent stock identities and bacterial V1-V2 amplicon measurements. Existing source quotations, vessel and transfer conditions, three community-level nodes, sole PARTIAL selection-to-phenotype arrow, discussions, issue 1767 disposition and original history remain unchanged. No necessary-member contribution, niche partitioning, hydrogen/methane flux or interspecies exchange is established. The crosswalk's upstream release is unestablished. This bounded correspondence correction does not complete scientific review, generated products or aggregate QC.
